title: ROAST RIBS OF BEEF
instructions: --Break off the ends of the bones of the desired amount of ribs; take out the shin-bone, and place
the meat in a baking pan. Sprinkle with salt and spread some small lumps of butter over it and dust with flour, baking in a moderate oven till done. Serve hot and garnish with horseradish.
